info.name: Recruiting
info.summary: Manage job applications, screening, interviews and rejections
info.description:
Recruiting covers your full hiring funnel inside Nextcloud: applications arrive by email or manual entry, the hiring team screens them, interviews are booked against interviewers' real calendars, and rejections go out — all from one place, and all on your own server.
**Intake**
* 📥 A dedicated IMAP mailbox is fetched automatically — every mail becomes a candidate, attachments become documents * 🎯 Plus-addressing (`jobs+backend-dev@…`) routes applications straight into the right opening * 📨 Optional automatic confirmation mail to the candidate * ✍️ Manual entry with drag-and-drop CV upload
**Screening**
* 🗂️ A pipeline board per opening: New → Screening → Interview → Offer * 👍 Simple votes (yes / maybe / no) with a comment — votes of others stay hidden until you cast your own * 💬 A discussion thread with @-mentions on every candidate * 🕐 A complete timeline: every stage change, vote, mail and interview
**Interviews**
* 📅 Free slots are proposed from the interviewers' Nextcloud calendars * 🔗 The candidate picks a slot on a public page — no account needed * 🗓️ Confirmed interviews land in the calendar with all interviewers invited * 🎥 A Talk room is created automatically for video interviews
**Communication & privacy**
* ✉️ Mail templates with placeholders, always previewed before sending, always logged * 🔒 Interviewers only see candidates assigned to them; documents are never exposed via Files * 🗑️ Candidates can be deleted completely on request (GDPR)
info.author: Frank Karlitschek
